//: BEHAVIOR for the QML shell. The counterpart to palette.json, which owns
//1: IDENTITY — same behavior-vs-identity split the rest of this repo uses
//2: (see docs/architecture.md). Shared across themes; lives at the repo root
//3: of the shell, not inside themes/.
//5: Every value below is transcribed from waybar/config.jsonc and the
//6: scripts/ constants, so the QML bar starts out behaving identically to the
//7: waybar it will eventually replace. Nothing here feeds waybar — waybar
//8: still reads its own config.jsonc. That duplication is deliberate and
//9: temporary; CI asserts the two cannot silently diverge.

bar.//islands: Three detached islands. The clock sits ALONE in center so that nothing variable-width can shift it off true screen center — see docs/bar.md.

workspaces.//: 1-5 always render; dormant ones draw in the `dormant` role rather than vanishing, so the bar reads as a row of stations. 6+ appear on demand.
workspaces.//1: `pills`: an 8px dot per workspace, the active one a 26px lozenge, numbers only on hover. `numbers`: the digit stations the bar launched with.

cava.//: The soundwave fused to the media chip. Streams block glyphs from scripts/waybar-cava.sh, which emits nothing in silence — so the wave exists only while sound does.

agenda.//: Next calendar event. Renders only when something is inside the horizon.

updates.//: Repo updates via checkupdates (pacman-contrib). Cheap local diff, so polled often.

aur.//: AUR updates via yay. Longer interval than `updates`: every check is a live query to the AUR's public RPC rather than a local diff.

temperature.//: Silent watchdog: renders NOTHING below criticalC. Appearing IS the signal.
temperature.//1: Resolved by hwmon NAME, never by index — /sys/class/hwmon numbering is not stable across boots. k10temp on AMD, coretemp on Intel; this box reports k10temp.

network.//: Silent watchdog, like temperature. Renders nothing while the link is up.

battery.//: Only renders on machines that HAVE a battery. A desktop showing nothing here is correct.

dnd.//: Renders ONLY while do-not-disturb is on: the muted bell appearing IS the signal.

//surfaces: The other shell surfaces. Launcher replaced wofi, osd replaced swayosd, session replaced wlogout; each reads its identity (radius, frame, glow) from palette.json and only its BEHAVIOR from here.

launcher.//: wofi was launched as --columns 2 --width 640 --height 480 with --allow-images: a two-column icon grid.
launcher.//1: With nothing typed the launcher shows ONE column of the apps you launch most (count, decayed by how long since the last launch), at most this many, and sizes the window to fit them; before anything has been launched it shows the first recentCount apps alphabetically. Typing switches to the full `columns` grid at `height`.

osd.//: How long the pill stays up after the last keypress, and the step each press moves.

session.//: Transcribed from the old wlogout/layout, in order. `destructive` tiles light red on hover instead of the readout color.
